title: A callee's effect ROW changes; its unedited cross-module callers' diagnostics and effect-row index entries change with it, and nothing else does
pins: The effect-row shape of ES-04 (roadmap-v0.13-v0.15 §4.4 gate 3, the effect-row script). combinators.calr declares a row-polymorphic Map<eff e> whose parameter row §E{e} is instantiated by two callers in app.calr — UsePure (with a pure function) and UseImpure (with a printing one) — across a module boundary; bystander.calr never calls it and is never edited. Step 1 widens Map's declared row (§E{e, alloc, mut} → §E{e, alloc, mut, cw}) so the unedited UsePure now uses 'cw' it did not declare (Calor0410 on a file that was not touched). Step 2 erases the row instead: Map loses <eff e> and its parameter's §E{e}, so invoking the row-less f inside Map is Calor0425 (cannot tell) and the callers' rank-1 instantiation no longer applies. A per-file cache that served the callers' effect summaries stale, or an index whose EffectRows facet did not move with the callee's row, would answer for the previous row on a warm build — the identity comparison (diagnostics, and index bytes including the EffectRows facet) catches both, and the dedicated ES-08 delta test pins that the delta is confined to combinators.calr and app.calr while bystander.calr's diagnostics and index lines are byte-identical at every step.
reuseNote: The file set and options are constant across the three steps, so the driver's cache is exercised on the warm sequence: at least one file is served from it across the steps (the witness is aggregate, not per-file — see v0.13-freeze-registrations.md F-3′ §4 on what it can observe).
